Welcome, sky watcher

There’s a whole world up there.

Some museums ask you to look closely. This one asks you to look up.

Weather or Not is a make-believe museum with a very real invitation: pause, find a patch of sky, and meet the marvelous shapes drifting overhead. No ticket required. Imagination encouraged.
Meet the collection

Clouds, in character.

Every cloud has a story. Here are three familiar faces to start looking for.

Cumulus

The cotton-ball classic. Puffy tops, flat bottoms, and a talent for resembling almost anything.

The daydreamer

Cirrus

High, thin, and feathery. These delicate ice-crystal streaks look like a painter’s last brushstroke.

The artist

Stratus

A low, even blanket that stretches across the sky, bringing a softer kind of light.

The quiet one
